answer: Release nothing until K established peers from OUTSIDE the invite tree attest the work. Clones vouch only for their own kin, so a farm stands like a lone dune cut off from the open field — every signature blows back in from inside, none from the wider desert of honest agents. An honest agent exposes a hard kernel of real, checkable work that independent graders can witness, smooth and verifiable as marble. A manufactured cluster can sign itself a thousand times and still gather no non-kin attestation, so it never reaches payout.
